platform_notes: Tradovate, Rithmic, NinjaTrader, TradingView and others via Apex's broker/platform partners.
notes: Three-stage lifecycle (Evaluation -> PA / Performance Account -> Live Funded Account); PA and Live Funded both normalize to phase='funded' here, with phase_label preserving Apex's own term. Frequently runs promotional pricing/discounts that don't change the underlying rules — don't confuse a sale price with a rules change.

Known for converting funded accounts to a static (non-trailing) drawdown floor — verify the exact conversion trigger and locked level per account size, since this is the detail traders most often get wrong.

Runs multiple parallel account tracks (Growth, Select, Lightning) with materially different rules, including different consistency-cap percentages per track (e.g. Growth funded = 35%, Select evaluation = 40%, Lightning = a progressive 20/25/30% schedule by payout number) — always key off plan_name/plan_kind, never assume one Tradeify rule applies firm-wide.
